note: The Attorney General, as Barbados Today reported (15 June 2023): the Barbados Identity Management Act makes the first issue free (section 10) and a replacement BBD 60 (section 13, not modelled). The card's term, the age from which it is issued and the time aren't in the report, and the government's information service refused this session, so they're left open: the card is offered at any age with its term unknown. The Parliament's copy of the Barbados Identity Management Bill, 2021, as passed by the House of Assembly (read 2026-11-03), gives a card valid 10 years, a minor's card under 16, a free first issue of either, a replacement of BBD 60, a same-day issue of BBD 100 and no fee at 65 or older. The Act as enacted wasn't read, and a bill isn't the rule in force, so none of these is held beyond what Barbados Today reports of the Act.

sources.title: Barbados Today, AG assures no cost for first Trident ID (15 June 2023)
sources.said: This stance runs throughout the Barbados Identity Management Act which sets out in clear terms in Section 10 that the first issue of an ID card is free of charge. Replacement cards are dealt with by Section 13 of the Act which provides that where the new ID card is to be replaced, that there is a $60 fee.

sources.title: Parliament of Barbados, Barbados Identity Management Bill, 2021 (bill details page https://www.barbadosparliament.com/bills/details/540: passed the House of Assembly, second reading 23/02/2021); the Bill, not the Act as enacted
sources.said: Third Schedule, Fees for Identification Cards: (a) Adult Barbados Identification Card: First Issue No charge (b) Minor Barbados Identification Card: First Issue No charge (c) Adult Barbados Identification Card: Replacement 60.00 (d) Minor Barbados Identification Card: Replacement 60.00 ... (f) Emergency (same day): (i) Issue of Adult Barbados Identification Card 100.00 (ii) Issue of Minor Barbados Identification Card 100.00. ... (2) ... an identification card referred to in subsection (1) shall be valid for a period of 10 years or for such period as the Commission may prescribe by order with the approval of the Minister. ... (5) A minor shall, on attaining 16 years of age, register in accordance with section 7 for an identification card. ... 'minor' means a person who is under 16 years of age
